metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Improve Circulation in Your Feet and Toes
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly improve blood flow and circulation in the feet and toes

This video will be broken up into different parts that will show exercises in different positions (including in bed and seated).

Make sure to go through them all, and use what gives you the best results. 

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may improve circulation within 30 seconds.

Let us know how the exercises work for you!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:42 Seated Exercise (Massage)
2:37 Seated Exercise (Toe/Heel Raises)
5:07 Bed Exercise
8:04 Toe Scrunches
